definitions.explanation: One of the pair of long, thin sense organs on the head of an insect, crustacean, or snail, used to feel, smell, and sense its surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蟻|あり}→蟻：04291_ari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{触角|しょっかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}いている→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。

examples.english: Snails have eyes at the tips of their feelers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{触角|しょっかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{感|かん}じ{取|と}って、⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: Insects pick up smells with their antennae and use them to find food.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {触角|しょっかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧: to move its antennae
- {触角|しょっかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧: to feel about with its antennae
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{触角|しょっかく}: long antennae

WATCH OUT:
⟦{触覚|しょっかく}→触覚：04426_shokkaku⟧ (the sense of touch) has the same reading. Writing ⟦{触覚|しょっかく}→触覚：04426_shokkaku⟧ for an insect's antennae is a common slip; the antennae are {触角|しょっかく} ({角|かく}, "horn").
